description: The ONE task to do now, and why it won — not a list. Picking from a list is work, and a session that has to pick tends to pick the easy one. A task whose dependencies are still open is never eligible, however loud it is. Says explicitly when the chosen one is the owner's to press rather than an agent's.

for.description: a role: the first ready task in the same order that this role may take. Its own task first, else one with no assignee that no other agent has claimed (task:<id>) and that passes the tag filters. The owner's tasks and tasks assigned to another role are never handed out. Returns {task, why, eligible, ready, skipped:{assigned, claimed, tags, owner}}. Not together with assignee.

onlyTags.description: with for: an unassigned task must carry at least one of these tags; the role's own tasks are not narrowed

skipTags.description: with for: a task carrying any of these tags is never handed out, the role's own included; why and skippedOwn name the own tasks kept back

name: hub_next
